text:
I went for a cleaning at 3 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310.
The dental hygienist spoke English but I felt that he had very little experience. He told me that my teeth looked good. He cleaned all teeth within 15 minutes. I have 2 bridges, he never cleaned underneath. At the end he told me that I had lime buildup on my lower teeth, but never used the scaling tool once.
It seemed a waste of 900 baht compared to the very good service that I get in my home country. I will not use their services again.

text:
I don't post reviews often but these guys are special! I went in today with serious tooth pain, really luxurious place, they were super professional, spoke english and then after consultation gave me 2 full injections of Anesthesia to extract my tooth. They tried and tried but just couldn't. So again, 2 more injections of Anesthesia and still it couldn't be done (due to the molar being too inflamed and infected)....then they explained it all to me, gave me an appointment for 3 days later at a time convenient for me outside of work PLUS PLUS PLUS 2 lots of required pre-medication before my next appointment.... Total price: FREE!
That's right - ZERO COST.
(This is possibly the best customer service I've ever had! - and the price was ALSO the lowest I could find!!)
